title: Kweendom
price_label: Free · donations to an LGBTQ org each month
description: Pete’s Candy Store’s monthly LGBTQ showcase of comedians and storytellers, with a collection each month for a different LGBTQ organization. Free, seating is first come first served, and the back room is tiny, so early is better.
verification_note: Monthly, not weekly. Eventbrite listings for 2026 fall on Jan 16, Feb 20, Mar 20, Apr 17, May 15, Jun 19, Jul 17 and Aug 21, each a third Friday at 7pm at Pete’s Candy Store; the Aug 21 page says the show is free, seating first come first served, donations collected “this month”.
